reason: Terminated by express supersession. Section 2 temporarily withdrew the tract (T. 4 S., R. 28 W., sec. 31, lots 1 and 5 of NW1/4, 79.50 acres) "Subject to all valid existing rights, the land" described in section 1, and section 3 provides that the withdrawal "shall continue in force until revoked by the President or by" act of Congress. Executive Order 7719, signed October 8, 1937, names the order by number and date: "The reservation made by this order supersedes the tem" [soft hyphen and line break] "withdrawal of the above-described land made by" "Executive Order No. 7628 of June 8, 1937." The tract it describes is the same 79.50 acres. Executive Order 7719 has no effective-date wording, so the end is dated on signing, 1937-10-08 (a reading, disclosed; the order was filed October 9 and printed October 12, 1937). Section 1's revocation of Executive Order No. 6964 as to this tract was performed on signing and left the withdrawal in section 2 as the only continuing command, so the first end of the order is the supersession of that withdrawal.
